cues.en: Mike: In this video, you are going to see the central limit theorem in action.
cues.zh: Mike：這部影片會看到中央極限定理實際發揮作用。

cues.en: It's gonna be super exciting, maybe not quite as exciting as a Hollywood Blockbuster movie, but you know, pretty cool nonetheless.
cues.zh: 非常精彩，也許沒有好萊塢大片那麼刺激，但仍然很酷。

cues.en: So what we are going to do is start by creating some data with a power-law distribution, or at least something that's, you know, sort of like a power-law distribution.
cues.zh: 先建立一些冪律分布的資料，或至少有點像冪律分布。

cues.en: It's not really formally a power-law, but we are going to generate data that are normally distributed, so Gaussian distributed, and then I'm going to square all of those values.
cues.zh: 不是真正正式的冪律，而是產生常態、高斯分布資料，再把所有數值平方。

cues.en: So let's see what these data look like.
cues.zh: 看看資料的樣子。

cues.en: Here you see all the individual data points, and it's just a sea of blue down here.
cues.zh: 每個點是個別資料點，這裡下面是一片藍色海洋。

cues.en: The clustering is so tight that you cannot distinguish the individual points, but you see that as the values get higher and higher, we have fewer and fewer data points.
cues.zh: 聚集得太密，無法分辨個別點，但數值越高，資料點就越少。

cues.en: And that's what also characterizes this histogram of the data here, that basically, as the values get larger, the probability of seeing those values gets smaller.
cues.zh: 這也是這張資料直方圖的特徵，基本上，數值越大，出現這些數值的機率越低。

cues.en: So there's very few large values and a lot more small values.
cues.zh: 所以大值很少，小值多很多。

cues.en: And this is what characterizes a power-law distribution or sometimes called a one over F distribution.
cues.zh: 這是冪律分布，或有時稱 1/f 分布的特徵。

cues.en: Okay, but the point of this here was to generate a strongly non-Gaussian distribution.
cues.zh: 但重點是，產生一個嚴重偏離高斯的分布。

cues.en: So you can see that this distribution looks nothing like a Gaussian.
cues.zh: 可以看到，這個分布完全不像高斯。

cues.en: Okay so now what we're going to do is take repeated samples of the data and compute the means of those samples.
cues.zh: 接著對資料重複抽樣，計算那些樣本的平均值。

cues.en: Now, this code here is almost exactly the same as what you've seen, maybe even twice already, certainly
cues.zh: 這段程式幾乎和之前看過的完全一樣，也許已經看過兩次，至少

cues.en: in the last code video, the law of large numbers video.
cues.zh: 上一部大數法則程式影片肯定看過。

cues.en: So, what we're doing is taking a random sample of our dataset of n equals 30.
cues.zh: 從資料集抽取 N=30 的隨機樣本。

cues.en: So a sample size of 30, and we are repeating the experiment 500 times.
cues.zh: 樣本大小為 30，重複實驗 500 次。

cues.en: Now with the law of large numbers, what we are interested in is the average of all of these sample means.
cues.zh: 大數法則關心的是，所有樣本平均值的平均。

cues.en: But for the central limit theorem, what we actually care about is not the average of these means, but the distribution of these means, and that's what I'm showing here.
cues.zh: 但中央極限定理在意的不是這些平均值的平均，而是其分布，這裡展示的就是如此。

cues.en: So this is a histogram of those sample means.
cues.zh: 這是樣本平均值的直方圖。

cues.en: And lo and behold, the means are Gaussian distributed.
cues.zh: 你看，平均值呈高斯分布。

cues.en: So we see a pretty normal looking distribution here.
cues.zh: 這裡看起來相當常態。

cues.en: And the mean looks to be about one.
cues.zh: 平均值似乎大約是 1。

cues.en: I'm curious to see what the mean of the entire dataset is.
cues.zh: 我很好奇，整個資料集的平均值是多少。

cues.en: So the mean of the entire dataset is pretty much exactly one.
cues.zh: 整個資料集的平均值幾乎恰好是 1。

cues.en: And we see that the mean of this, and now actually this is going to be the law of large numbers in effect.
cues.zh: 這裡這個平均值，現在其實就是大數法則發揮作用。

cues.en: I'm gonna take the mean of the sample average, and you can see it's a little bit less than one.
cues.zh: 取樣本平均值的平均，可以看到略低於 1。

cues.en: So they're fairly close, they're pretty close to each other.
cues.zh: 兩者相當接近。

cues.en: Okay but so the central limit theorem tells us that this distribution of sample means is going to be Gaussian, even though the distribution that they're drawn from is non-Gaussian.
cues.zh: 中央極限定理告訴我們，樣本平均值的這個分布會是高斯，即使抽樣來源分布不是高斯。

cues.en: That's a pretty wild thing about how the universe works.
cues.zh: 宇宙這種運作方式，真的很神奇。

cues.en: It this never ceases to amaze me.
cues.zh: 總是讓我驚嘆。

cues.en: Okay and if you are curious, I also have an alternative dataset here, and this is just a sine.
cues.zh: 如果好奇，這裡還有另一組資料，就是正弦。

cues.en: So it's just a pure sine wave goes from 0 to 10 pi.
cues.zh: 一個從 0 到 10π 的純正弦波。

cues.en: There's nothing special about 10 pi that just gives us a bunch of cycles.
cues.zh: 10π 沒什麼特別，只是提供好幾個週期。

cues.en: So here's what that dataset looks like, and here is the distribution of the data points from a sine wave.
cues.zh: 這是資料集的樣子，這裡是正弦波資料點的分布。

cues.en: It's a little weird at first that you see these increases towards minus one and plus one.
cues.zh: 剛開始看到靠近 −1 和 +1 的數量增加，會有點奇怪。

cues.en: But the reason why that happens is because the sine wave kind of slows down a little bit here as it curves around the trough and as it curves around the peak.
cues.zh: 原因是，正弦波繞過波谷和波峰時，有點像慢了下來。

cues.en: So the data points are closer to each other up here, and they're further apart from each other over here on the rising slope and the falling slope.
cues.zh: 所以這裡的資料點彼此更接近，而上升斜坡和下降斜坡這裡，資料點彼此距離較遠。

cues.en: And so that's why you see this increase.
cues.zh: 因此會看到這個增加。

cues.en: Again, totally non-Gaussian distribution.
cues.zh: 同樣，完全不是高斯分布。

cues.en: If anything, it's the opposite of a Gaussian, right?
cues.zh: 真要說，有點像高斯的相反，對吧？

cues.en: It's almost like you flip a Gaussian upside down because you have the peaks are at the edges and the low parts are in the middle.
cues.zh: 幾乎像把高斯上下翻轉，因為峰在兩側，低處在中間。

cues.en: Okay and again, you are not going to be surprised to see that the distribution of the means over all these different random samples is a Gaussian.
cues.zh: 同樣地，各個隨機樣本平均值的分布是高斯，你應該不會意外。

cues.en: So in the video I described two different facets of the central limit theorem.
cues.zh: 影片中介紹中央極限定理的兩個不同面向。

cues.en: This is one of 'em that repeated samples of a distribution will have means that are distributed as a Gaussian.
cues.zh: 這是其中一個：重複抽取某分布的樣本，其平均值會呈高斯分布。

cues.en: And the second aspect of the central limit theorem is that when you mix together randomly, so randomly mixing together data drawn
cues.zh: 中央極限定理的第二個面向，是隨機混合抽樣得到的資料，

cues.en: from different distributions, then the combined distribution will also approach a Gaussian.
cues.zh: 這些資料來自不同分布，而合成後的分布也會接近高斯分布。

cues.en: So what I'm doing here is creating two datasets with non-Gaussian distributions.
cues.zh: 這裡建立兩組非高斯分布的資料。

cues.en: These are in fact the two datasets that I showed in the slides.
cues.zh: 其實就是投影片展示的那兩組。

cues.en: So this is basically just recreating one of the slides I showed you.
cues.zh: 基本上是在重現其中一張投影片。

cues.en: So we have a pure sine wave and we have uniform distributed random numbers.
cues.zh: 有一個純正弦波，以及均勻分布隨機數。

cues.en: So you can see it's rand and then size of X.
cues.zh: 可以看到是 rand，再輸入 X 的大小。

cues.en: That's just the variable that I'm evaluating the sine wave on.
cues.zh: X 就是求正弦波值時使用的變數。

cues.en: And now I'm multiplying by two and subtracting one.
cues.zh: 再乘以 2，減去 1。

cues.en: And that's because uniformly distributed random numbers go from zero to one.
cues.zh: 因為均勻分布隨機數原本介於 0 和 1。

cues.en: So then I multiply them by two, and this gives me uniformly distributed numbers between zero and two.
cues.zh: 乘以 2，就得到 0 和 2 之間的均勻分布數字。

cues.en: And then I subtract one, and then we get a final range of minus one to plus one.
cues.zh: 再減去 1，最終範圍就是 −1 到 +1。

cues.en: Now, that puts the noise at in the same scale as the sine wave.
cues.zh: 這讓雜訊和正弦波處於相同尺度。

cues.en: And you might remember in the previous video I said that this aspect of the law of large numbers, that random linear mixtures of non-Gaussian distributions will tend
cues.zh: 也許記得前一部影片說過，大數法則的這個面向，就是非高斯分布的隨機線性混合會趨向

cues.en: towards a Gaussian distribution.
cues.zh: 高斯分布。

cues.en: That fact depends on proper scaling and normalization.
cues.zh: 這件事取決於適當的縮放和正規化。

cues.en: So basically all the variables have to be roughly in the same scale.
cues.zh: 基本上，所有變數必須大致在相同尺度。

cues.en: And I'll give you a demonstration of that in a moment.
cues.zh: 等一下會示範。

cues.en: Okay, so let me just run this code and that will produce this figure.
cues.zh: 執行程式，產生這張圖。

cues.en: So what we see here is the two signals, so the sine wave and the pure noise and here is these two combined.
cues.zh: 這裡是兩個訊號，也就是正弦波和純雜訊，這裡則是兩者結合。

cues.en: So this plus this equals this.
cues.zh: 這個加這個，等於這個。

cues.en: Here you see the distribution of the sine wave, the distribution of the noise.
cues.zh: 這裡是正弦波分布，以及雜訊分布。

cues.en: And this is the distribution of the combined signal.

cues.zh: 想指出、確保清楚的是，這裡看的不是分布的總和。

cues.en: So it's not this thing plus this thing, it is the distribution of the signals summed together.

cues.en: And then we take the histogram of this and that you see in this line of code here.

cues.en: So I'm not adding together the histogram data, I'm adding together the two signals and then taking their histogram.
cues.zh: 不是把直方圖資料相加，而是將兩個訊號相加，再取直方圖。

cues.en: Okay and then the last thing I want to do is just illustrate the importance of scaling for this linear mixture tending towards Gaussian.
cues.zh: 最後要示範，線性混合趨近高斯時，縮放的重要性。

cues.en: And so I'm gonna multiply this by 10 just to increase the amplitude of the sine wave by quite a bit.
cues.zh: 將這裡乘以 10，大幅增加正弦波振幅。

cues.en: Run this code again and you see that these two haven't changed qualitatively.
cues.zh: 再執行，這兩個在定性上沒有改變。

cues.en: The only thing that's different is this y-axis scaling on this signal.
cues.zh: 唯一不同，是這個訊號的 Y 軸尺度。

cues.en: This distribution looks the same, this distribution looks the same.
cues.zh: 這個分布看起來一樣，這個也一樣。

cues.en: And now the combined signal looks much more like a sine wave.
cues.zh: 現在合成訊號更像正弦波。

cues.en: No surprise, we're adding a much smaller noise relative to the signal.
cues.zh: 不意外，因為相對於訊號，加入的雜訊小很多。

cues.en: And now this distribution still looks nothing like a Gaussian.
cues.zh: 現在這個分布仍然完全不像高斯。

cues.en: So the central limit theorem is valid depending on appropriate scaling of the individual signals that are getting mixed together.
cues.zh: 所以中央極限定理是否有效，取決於混合的個別訊號是否適當縮放。

cues.en: I'm gonna start by illustrating the first of two concepts or aspects of the central limit theorem that I discussed in the previous video.
cues.zh: 先示範前一部影片中，中央極限定理兩個概念或面向的第一個。

cues.en: This is actually the aspect that's most relevant for inferential statistics, and that is that the means of random samples from data will tend

cues.en: towards a Gaussian distribution regardless of the shape of the distribution of the data.
cues.zh: 高斯分布，不管資料本身的分布形狀如何。

cues.zh: 所以要產生非高斯分布資料。

cues.zh: 資料看起來有點像冪律。

cues.zh: 不完全正式遵循冪律函數，基本上只是隨機雜訊。

cues.en: So Gaussian normally distributed noise, and then all of those numbers are squared.
cues.zh: 也就是高斯、常態分布雜訊，再把所有數字平方。

cues.en: So let's see what the data look like and we'll see a histogram.
cues.zh: 看看資料和直方圖。

cues.en: So you see each dot is a data point, and here you just see just solid blue.
cues.zh: 每個點都是資料點，這裡只看到一整片藍色。

cues.en: And that's because the density here of points is so thick.
cues.zh: 因為這裡資料點密度太高。

cues.en: And then as we get to higher and higher values, we get fewer and fewer data points.
cues.zh: 數值越高，資料點越少。

cues.en: Here you see the histogram.
cues.zh: 這裡是直方圖。

cues.en: And what characterizes a power-law distribution also sometimes called a one over F distribution, is that larger values are less frequent in the data,
cues.zh: 冪律分布，有時也稱 1/f 分布的特徵，就是較大數值在資料中出現較少，

cues.zh: 要對資料集重複抽樣，樣本大小為 30，並隨機重複這個實驗 500 次，

cues.en: of this experiment.

cues.zh: 實際上，繞過波谷和波峰時，資料點在 Y 軸上彼此更接近，而在上升斜坡和下降斜坡時，資料點

cues.zh: 不完全是高斯，但肯定比這兩個個別分布更像高斯。

cues.en: A proper scaling of these original signals is important.

cues.zh: 所以把正弦波乘以 10。

cues.zh: 不會改變正弦波形狀，也沒有改變均勻雜訊。

cues.en: So all this is doing is increasing the amplitude of the sine wave and that you see here in the y-axis.
cues.zh: 只是增加正弦波振幅，可以從這裡 Y 軸看出。

cues.zh: 同一個正弦波，現在從 −10 到 +10，而不是 −1 到 +1。

cues.en: And the effect of that is that the noise now is one 10th of the magnitude of the signal.
cues.zh: 效果是，雜訊大小現在只有訊號的十分之一。

cues.en: So now you see, well now the combined signal looks much more like a sine wave, no surprise, and the combined distribution, so the histogram
cues.zh: 所以合成訊號看起來更像正弦波，不意外，而合成分布，也就是這個訊號的直方圖，

cues.en: of this signal now doesn't really look anything like a Gaussian.
cues.zh: 現在完全不像高斯。

cues.zh: 再次提醒，中央極限定理的第二個面向說，訊號的隨機線性混合，即使來自非高斯分布，也會趨向
